reference.title: Scenario 8: checklists in a reference topic

section.p: Consider a "Pre-Startup Inspection Checklist" chapter in a "Pump Station Maintenance Reference Guide" document where operators need a quick lookup list of items that must be verified before starting an industrial pumping system. Since the information serves as a reference that users consult repeatedly, document it in a reference topic using a simple list.
section.codeblock:
Pre-Startup Inspection Checklist Verify the following items before starting the pumping system.
Startup Readiness Checklist
  • Suction and discharge valves are in the correct operating position.
  • Oil levels in the pump bearings are within the recommended range.
  • Electrical connections and grounding cables are secure.
  • Pressure gauges and flow indicators are functioning correctly.
  • Safety guards and protective covers are installed and undamaged.
  • The work area is free of obstructions, spills, and safety hazards.
section.p: Result: Use unordered lists (<ul>) for checklists in reference topics because the information is intended for lookup and verification rather than procedural execution. Avoid turning checklists into task topics when no sequence of actions exists.
